hooks.name: console_line
hooks.neoforge: none (Bukkit's ServerCommandEvent and RemoteServerCommandEvent; NeoForge's CommandEvent hears parsed commands only)

rust_summary: every line the dedicated server's console or RCON is about to run, cancellable, with replies (`native_console_line`).
doc_summary: every console and RCON line before it runs, cancellable, with replies: `native_console_line(source, line, cancel, replies)`, `source` being `console` or `rcon`. Bundles need "hooks": @API:console_line@.
